# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment
The baseline passes simulation, but timing is infeasible: setup WNS is −9.918 ns at 6.667 ns, while hold WHS is +0.158 ns. The reported critical path to `sum_pipe0` has 14 logic levels, including a five-DSP cascade and carry logic; LUT and FF use are low at 101 and 192, with 6 DSPs and no BRAM. The top has authoritative known latency 1, so retain `// @latency 1` and preserve the exact observable cycle behavior.

## Hypothesis
Splitting the eight-tap MAC into two balanced four-tap partial sums registered in parallel, then adding those partials in the next existing pipeline stage, should shorten the register-to-register critical path and may recover timing at the cost of roughly 32 FFs.

## Instruction for generator
Replace the single eight-product expression feeding `sum_pipe0` with two registered 32-bit partial sums, each formed from four tap products using balanced addition; in the next existing stage, add the prior-cycle partial sums into `sum_pipe1`. Keep `y_out`’s existing delayed assignment and reset behavior, and retain the delay line, ports, parameter widths and signedness, `// @latency 1`, and all cycle behavior. Preserve 32-bit modulo arithmetic for every supported coefficient value; do not add pipeline stages.
